profiles.notes: 2027 Agriculture, mainstream Engineering and Military first-entry programme conditions. Lowercase grades denote AS and uppercase grades Ordinary Level. Indicative UNAM points do not define IB diploma totals. Preserve slash groups until clarified. Catalogue codes, campuses and integrated four-year Honours distinguish these awards from Extended and standalone Honours. MAE-only and catalogue N/A routes do not inherit Science RPL eligibility.

requirements.label: Agriculture diplomas: AS agriculture/science and Ordinary Mathematics/English
requirements.details: Both diploma rows print Agriculture/Biology e at AS-level; Physical Science e at AS-level OR the literal Physics/Chemistry D group at Ordinary Level; Mathematics D and English D at Ordinary Level. The slash groups are retained without inventing whether one or both named subjects satisfy them; a separate source-grouping clarification applies.

requirements.label: Agricultural Economics: AS Mathematics and agriculture/biology d
requirements.details: The row requires Mathematics d at AS-level, English C at Ordinary Level and the literal Agriculture/Biology d group at AS-level. Its separate 27+ indicative-point guidance does not replace these subjects. The slash grouping is not silently interpreted as AND or OR.

requirements.label: Crop Production: AS biology/agriculture and science alternative
requirements.details: The row prints Biology/Agriculture d at AS-level, Physical Science d at AS-level OR the literal Chemistry/Physics C group at Ordinary Level, and Mathematics C and English C at Ordinary Level. Preserve the stated Physical Science alternative and the unexpanded slash groups; Mathematics is Ordinary C here, not AS d.

requirements.label: Fisheries/Ocean Sciences: Biology d, science group d, Mathematics/English C
requirements.details: The row prints Biology d and the literal Physics/Chemistry d group at AS-level, with Mathematics C and English C at Ordinary Level. The advanced science slash group is not assumed to mean either one or both sciences without programme clarification.

requirements.label: Food Science/Technology: Biology, Mathematics and science group d
requirements.details: The row requires Biology d and Mathematics d at AS-level, the literal Chemistry/Physics d group at AS-level, and English C at Ordinary Level. The group interpretation remains flagged; no new IB offer is calculated from these Namibian subject grades.

requirements.label: Animal Science: AS agriculture/biology, Mathematics d and Ordinary science group
requirements.details: The row prints Biology/Agriculture d and Mathematics d at AS-level; the literal Chemistry/Physics C group and English C at Ordinary Level. Its Ordinary science grade differs from Food Science/Technology's AS d science group.

requirements.label: Seven Engineering degrees: AS Mathematics/Physics/Chemistry c
requirements.details: Agricultural Engineering and the six mainstream Engineering rows each require Mathematics c, Physics c and Chemistry c at AS-level, and English C at Ordinary Level. All three advanced subjects remain required; the capital English C is a different level. The 32+ indicative-point record is additional, not a course IB diploma-total minimum.

requirements.label: Nautical/Aeronautical Science: AS Mathematics and Physical Science d
requirements.details: The two rows require Mathematics d and Physical Science d at AS-level, with English C at Ordinary Level. Nautical Science is the three-year NQF7 award and Aeronautical Science Honours is the integrated four-year NQF8 award; their shared subject set does not merge their identities.

requirements.label: Military Geography: AS Geography/History c and three Ordinary C subjects
requirements.details: The row requires Geography c and History c at AS-level, plus Mathematics C, English C and Physical Science C at Ordinary Level. The complete rendered page confirms Geography c where extracted font text is corrupted. It is not the same subject set as Nautical or Aeronautical Science.

requirements.label: 2027 Engineering: indicative 32+ UNAM points
requirements.details: Agricultural Engineering and all six mainstream Engineering rows print 32+ UNAM evaluation points. The guide labels its points indicative for 2027 and allows consideration of strong applications slightly below. The specific AS c science/mathematics and Ordinary English conditions remain additional. This guideline is not a guaranteed offer, an IB total, or the 27+ guidance of the other linked faculty degrees.

requirements.label: Agriculture subject slash groups need programme confirmation
requirements.details: The guide prints Agriculture/Biology (or Biology/Agriculture) and Physics/Chemistry (or Chemistry/Physics) without defining every slash as AND, OR or a named combined subject. It separately uses an explicit OR for the Physical Science alternative in the two diplomas and Crop Production. The individual grades/levels are preserved, but those slash-group meanings need faculty confirmation before advising that one named subject can be omitted.

requirements.label: 2027 Engineering catalogue: MAE/RPL not advertised
requirements.details: The MAE/RPL column reads N/A for Agricultural Engineering and all six mainstream Engineering programmes. No alternative MAE or RPL eligibility is inferred for these entries from the general university policy. Any exceptional alternative entry would need a specific faculty source; this catalogue entry is not converted into an unsupported universal ban on all prior-tertiary applicants.

requirements.label: 2027 Ogongo: Agriculture diploma and Crop Production codes
requirements.details: Ogongo Campus offers Livestock Production Diploma 31DLP and Sustainable Crop Production and Technologies Diploma 31DCPT, both three-year NQF6, and BSc Crop Production 31BSCP, three-year NQF7. All are full-time and the catalogue lists MAE. The guide's shortened Sustainable Production and Technologies title is reconciled with the canonical crop-diploma code, not a second award.

requirements.label: 2027 Neudamm: Agricultural Economics and Animal Science
requirements.details: At Neudamm Campus the catalogue lists Agricultural Economics 31BSAE as a full-time three-year NQF7 BSc and Animal Science Honours 31BSAS as a full-time four-year integrated NQF8 degree. Both list MAE. The latter is not one of the separate one-year Honours continuation programmes.

requirements.label: 2027 Fisheries/Ocean Sciences: 31BFOS at Sam Nujoma
requirements.details: The three-year full-time NQF7 BSc Fisheries and Ocean Sciences is code 31BFOS at Sam Nujoma Campus, with MAE listed. It is distinct from the separate Fisheries and Ocean Sciences Honours continuation award 31BFOH.

requirements.label: 2027 Food Science/Technology: four-year Honours at Windhoek Main
requirements.details: Food Science and Technology Honours is code 31BHFT at Windhoek Main Campus, full-time for four years at NQF8, with MAE listed. It is an integrated first-entry degree, not a one-year Honours requiring an invented prior BSc qualification.

requirements.label: 2027 Engineering code/campus and four-year identities
requirements.details: At Josè Eduardo dos Santos Campus, the full-time four-year NQF8 programmes are Agricultural Engineering Honours 31BHAE, Civil 32BHVI, Electrical 32BHEI, Electronics and Computer 32BHCI, Mechanical 32BHNI, Metallurgical 32BHTI and Mining 32BHMI. The six non-agricultural catalogue titles omit Honours while the career guide includes it; they are reconciled to the same codes. Separate five-year Extended codes are not assigned these mainstream entry requirements.

requirements.label: 2027 Military Science: three first-entry programme identities
requirements.details: At Windhoek Main Campus, Nautical Science 34BSNS and Military Geography 34BMGH are full-time three-year NQF7 BSc degrees, while Aeronautical Science Honours 34BSAS is a full-time four-year integrated NQF8 degree. The catalogue lists MAE for these three. One-year Nautical/Military Honours continuation awards are separate and are not merged with them.

profiles.notes: 2027 Agriculture, mainstream Engineering and Military first-entry programme conditions. Lowercase grades denote AS and uppercase grades Ordinary Level. Indicative UNAM points do not define IB diploma totals. Preserve slash groups until clarified. Catalogue codes, campuses and integrated four-year Honours distinguish these awards from Extended and standalone Honours. MAE-only and catalogue N/A routes do not inherit Science RPL eligibility.

requirements.label: Agriculture/Military MAE: advertised routes and eligibility
requirements.details: The catalogue advertises MAE for these ten linked first-entry programmes; it does not advertise RPL for them. MAE applicants must be at least 25 on the first academic day and show at least five years of work experience relevant to the proposed programme. Degree entry needs completed senior-secondary schooling, diploma entry junior-secondary schooling. Programme-specific MAE conditions, examination and possible interview remain applicable. A shared MAE/RPL calendar does not grant an unadvertised RPL route.
